title: OFAC Sanctions Screening (SDN List)
description: Screen a list of people, companies or vessels against the US Treasury OFAC SDN list and its aliases, downloaded fresh each run. Returns, per name, whether there is a potential match, the score, and the SDN entry, type, programs and remarks.
why: Fuzzy matching on normalized names (punctuation and legal suffixes stripped, word order ignored) against every SDN name and alias. A potential match is a reason to review, not a determination.
useCases: Fintechs, marketplaces and exporters screening counterparties
AI agents running a KYC step

minScore.title: Minimum match score (0-1)
minScore.description: Similarity threshold. 0.85 is a sensible default.

limits: Screens the SDN list only (not the consolidated non-SDN lists). Results are potential matches for human review.
